create_base64_augmenter_all: create a Base64 text augmenter that encodes all input text to base64 with granularity set to all
create_base64_augmenter_word: create a Base64 text augmenter that encodes individual words to base64 with granularity set to word
run_base64_substitute: run the Base64 augmenter substitute method on a string to get base64 encoded text output
test_base64_encode: test the Base64 encode method by encoding a sample string and verifying the base64 output
review_base64_init: review the Base64 class init to understand aug_min aug_max aug_p and granularity parameter constraints
